interface.signature: def isMatch(s: str, p: str) -> bool

preconditions.description: Both s and p must be strings.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The string s must contain only lowercase letters.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz?*' for c in p)
preconditions.description: The pattern p must contain only lowercase letters, '?', and '*'.

postconditions.expression: return_value == (s == p or (p == '*' and len(s) >= 0) or (p == '?' and len(s) == 1))
postconditions.description: The function returns true if s matches p exactly, or if p is '*' and s is any length, or if p is '?' and s is a single character.

postconditions.expression: return_value == any(isMatch(s[i:], p[1:]) for i in range(len(s) + 1)) if p[0] == '*' else return_value == (s[0] == p[0] or p[0] == '?') and isMatch(s[1:], p[1:])
postconditions.description: The function returns true if the first character of p is '*' and any suffix of s matches the rest of p, or if the first characters of s and p match or p starts with '?', and the rest of s matches the rest of p.
